caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rounded, clover-shaped top that features a rich brown color with visible dark wood grain patterns. The table has a slightly decorative apron beneath the tabletop. Supporting the table are two vertically aligned, turned legs, each featuring carved detailing and striations. These legs connect at the base to a central, angular platform. Extending from this platform are four curved legs, each decorated with carved patterns and ending in claw-shaped feet that are fitted with small brass or gold-colored castors. The background is plain, and the entire composition is centered within a simple rectangular border.
title: Table Pedestal
